name: iPhone 16 Pro

masks.name: status-bar
masks.why: The OS status bar and Dynamic Island replace the design's drawn ones (different island geometry, the real clock in the accessibility tree, possible breadcrumb).

masks.name: home-indicator
masks.why: simctl screenshots leave the home indicator out and the design render hides it; the mask keeps a capture that does include it from failing. Content never sits here (the body keeps a 34 pt bottom inset).

measured: 2026-09-28, macOS 27.0, Xcode 26.6, iOS 26.5 (23F77): UIKit probe safeAreaInsets top 62 / bottom 34, status bar 54; simctl screenshot 1206 x 2622 RGBA sRGB in about 0.16 s, identical across captures and reboots; the Dynamic Island is drawn, the home indicator is not.
